acceptance: The stable package exports the localeconfig node kind with declared required and optional attributes and the documented accepted locale-tag subset, without framework, model-provider, or database coupling.

Deterministic node validation reports DOMAIN_INVALID_LOCALE_TAG for every locale attribute and every supported or right-to-left list entry that is outside the accepted subset, and reports DOMAIN_UNSUPPORTED_LOCALE_REFERENCE when a syntactically valid reference is not among the supported locales.
A locale configuration whose default, fallback, formatting, and right-to-left locales are all supported, and whose fallback or right-to-left metadata is absent, validates with no issues.
Issue collection remains total and deterministic across repeated runs, node insertion orders, and JSON object key orders, under the documented phase order and sort key.
Domain validation does not mutate, reorder, or normalize its input, and well-formed Product Graph v1 canonical revision identity is unchanged by domain validation.
Focused locale tests plus the full repository format, lint, typecheck, and test suites pass on the exact candidate, and Ubuntu and Windows CI both pass.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution with semantic review, and Jev typed judgments are recorded before guarded merge.

required: Stable @ineractive/product-graph localeconfig node kind with the documented locale-tag subset and the two deterministic locale error codes, with focused tests.
Proof that an invalid tag and an unsupported reference both fail closed and that canonical revision identity is unchanged for well-formed documents.
Exact-candidate Diffcipline proof, Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution with semantic review, and Jev typed judgments.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI plus post-merge fresh-main qualification.

minimality.rationale: Extend the already-qualified stable package with one bounded node kind and one deterministic tag validator plus focused tests, instead of adding a package, promoting the prototype lab, or introducing a runtime dependency or framework adapter.

requirements: Locale validation composes on top of the node, edge, relation, and governance layers delivered by SG-000020 through SG-000024 and the Product Graph v1 core contract, and must never weaken or bypass any of them.
Deterministic validation must not depend on object iteration accidents, wall-clock time, randomness, network access, locale of the host process, or model inference.
The locale-tag subset must be documented as an Ineractive validation subset, not as a claim of full BCP-47 conformance.

outcome: The stable @ineractive/product-graph domain layer declares a deterministic localeconfig node kind carrying a default locale, a supported-locale list, an optional fallback locale, optional right-to-left locale metadata, an optional formatting locale, and an optional user-selection flag, and reports a syntactically invalid locale tag or a locale reference that is not among the supported locales with stable error codes.
rationale: SG-000024 delivered the privacy slice of IN-P02-S02-T02 and deferred locale and internationalization semantics to this dependent Grain; the canonical frontend toolchain requires locale and RTL semantics to live in the Product Graph rather than in a framework adapter.

risk.recovery: Revert the SG-000025 localeconfig node kind, the locale-tag subset and its validator, the two stable error codes, the focused tests, the evidence record, and the current-frontier update; the SG-000020 through SG-000024 domain, governance, and privacy layers, the Product Graph v1 contracts, and ADR-0003 remain intact and no production state is mutated.

scope_in: Declare a deterministic localeconfig node kind with the required default-locale and supported-locale-list attributes and the optional fallback-locale, right-to-left-list, formatting-locale, and user-selection attributes.

Declare and document the accepted locale-tag subset used by the validator: a two-or-three-letter language subtag, an optional four-letter script subtag, and an optional two-letter-or-three-digit region subtag.
Add the stable node-phase error code DOMAIN_INVALID_LOCALE_TAG for a locale attribute or list entry that is outside the accepted locale-tag subset.

Add the stable node-phase error code DOMAIN_UNSUPPORTED_LOCALE_REFERENCE for a locale reference that is syntactically valid but is not among the declared supported locales, covering the default, fallback, formatting, and right-to-left references.

Add focused deterministic tests covering every accepted locale-tag shape, rejected tag shapes, each unsupported-reference case with its negative cases, deterministic ordering, no input mutation, and unchanged canonical revision identity.
Advance specs/CURRENT.md to record SG-000024 canonical closure and SG-000025 as the active frontier Grain.
scope_out: No translated-content or non-translatable-identifier semantics, no route-localization or locale-routing semantics, and no page, component, or content field changes; those belong to a later content and UI slice.
No external-effect, Dataset, design-system, skill, exploration-branch, or release semantics, and no change to the classification, lifecycle, or privacy vocabularies.
No Change Intent, proposed graph delta, Question Gate, Assumption Ledger, graph views, compiler, database, Supabase migration, remote side effect, or framework adapter such as a Next.js i18n library.
No new workspace package, no new runtime dependency, no lockfile change, and no relaxation of existing rejection behavior.
title: IN-P02-S02-T02D Implement locale and internationalization semantics
